raw_response:
I farm only 8 mu, so I will keep things simple and practical. I will put most of my land into the wheat-maize rotation because that is the steadiest way for me to secure grain and use my well irrigation well. I will keep a smaller piece in cotton because I already know how to grow it, but I will not give it too much land because it takes more labor and management. Since I have farmed for 30 years and do not want to take unnecessary risk, I will use improved seed for wheat, hybrid seed for maize, and improved cotton seed. I will fertilize wheat and maize more steadily because they are my main crops, and I will irrigate according to the well water I have, especially at key growth stages. I will use rotary tillage because it saves labor and suits my small farm. I will control pests when needed, but I will not spray excessively because that costs money. My goal is stable yield, manageable labor, and reliable household grain and cash income.
